name: actprove_blackbox
capacity_note: NVMe sized for >=1-2 h continuous at V1 rates (camera_ts @ 60 Hz, tracks @ 60 Hz, ownship @ 50 Hz, mavlink_tx @ 20 Hz).

files.meta.json: run identity, git sha, ICD version

tracks.jsonl.measurement_epoch_ns: int64 — coast keeps last real measurement epoch

files.boxes.jsonl: optional mirror of DetectionMsg for G1

bda.jsonl.cmd: TARGET_DESTROYED|MISS|REATTACK (UX labels; wire string for miss/reattack is MISS/REATTACK)

gcs_events.jsonl.note: GCS-side / demo events mirrored into blackbox when available

rules: Never block capture thread — async queue on hot path (TODO: ring + writer thread).
Soft now() forbidden for measurement_epoch fields.
